author: Dylan Morgan
description: OpenAI announced on Tuesday that it closed its latest funding round with $122 billion at an $852 billion valuation, its largest round to date. Softbank co-led the round alongside a16z, D. E. Shaw Ventures, MGX TPG, and T. Rowe Price Associates. title: OpenAI Raises $122 Billion at $852 Billion Valuation
